srf-paramdesc-filtered-map-layers: Lakabyada aasaasiga ah ee khariidadda, oo loo bixiyay magacyada bixiyeyaasha leaflet-providers ama magacyada lakabyada gaarka ah ee ay qeexday kordhinta Maps. Lakabka koowaad ayaa marka hore la soo bandhigayaa; marka wax ka badan hal la bixiyo, waxaa lagu daraa beddelaha lakabyada. Marka la dejiyo, dejimaha bixiyaha khariidadda waa la iska indhatiraa.
srf-paramdesc-filtered-map-geojson: Magaca bogga GeoJson ama URL-ka ay GeoJSON-kiisu ugu sawiran yahay lakab dul-saaran khariidadda. Waxay u baahan tahay kordhinta Maps. Lakabka dul saarku kama saameeyo shaandheeyayaasha, waxaana laga shidi karaa ama laga damin karaa beddelaha lakabyada.
srf-paramdesc-filtered-map-zoom:
Heerka soo-dhoweynta marka khariidadda la soo geliyo. Tan waxaa beddeli kara isticmaalaha.
Eeg: soo-dhoweynta ugu yar ee muuqaalka khariidadda iyo soo-dhoweynta ugu badan ee muuqaalka khariidadda
srf-paramdesc-filtered-map-min-zoom: Heerka ugu yar ee soo dhoweynta khariidadda ee la dooran karo
srf-paramdesc-filtered-map-max-zoom: Heerka ugu badan ee soo-dhoweynta khariidadda ee la dooran karo
srf-paramdesc-filtered-map-marker-cluste: Daar ama dami isu ururinta calaamadaha.
Heerka ugu sarreeya ee soo dhoweynta ee calaamadaha khariidaddu weli isu-urursan yihiin. Heerkan ka sarreeya calaamaduhu mar walba ma ahaan doonaan kuwo isu urursan.
Gacan ku dheeraadka ugu sarreeya ee kooxdu ka dabooli doonto calaamadda dhexe (pixels ahaan). Sida caadiga ah 80.
Marka la dhaqaajiyo, gujinta kooxdu waxay soo dhoweyn doontaa xuduudaheeda.
